claim_title: Intervention preserves validity within the non-inferiority margin (dose-validity tradeoff)

figures.caption: Helix-vs-validity frontier for site-28 CAA across the coefficient sweep: helix gain rises with coefficient while validity rate falls. The winning setting (coef 1.0) is the max helix gain with validity non-inferior (one-sided 95% LB > -0.05 margin); coef >=2 fails the margin.
